display_name_zh: 总控维护｜稳定认知入口、系统性修复闭环与有限验证收敛
governing_outcome: 在不增加额外付费 API/积分/Codex 依赖的前提下，让原生 ChatGPT 总控/域会话稳定进入当前 UAOS cognition/evolution；问题语境中的用户/模型修法不能绕过 intervention admission；关键自我质疑 gate 必须优先于普通 bootstrap；Native Skill 不能成为手工影子 authority；控制面变更必须有精确 durable admission；GitHub main 必须远端拒绝绕过 PR/CI 的直接写入。
observations: Existing long-chat trigger passed with context-contamination limitation and rejected the 10-rule repair.
Fresh-chat cold-start trigger failed: authority recovery succeeded but the user-proposed 10-rule remedy was still executed without cognition/evolution re-admission.
PR #83 produced a hand-edited Skill-only normative layer while current task authority still held the same intervention at NO_CHANGE_WITH_EVIDENCE.
User correction exposed a salience/order failure: the decisive self-questioning gate was not first or visually salient enough, allowing verbal skepticism plus behavioral compliance.
One raw GitHub create_file call later omitted branch and wrote directly to main, proving model-level candidate-workflow instructions alone were insufficient at the production ref.
GitHub ruleset protect-main is now independently reread as active on the default branch with empty bypass, required PR and promotion-gate, deletion block and non-fast-forward/force-push block.

PR #84 initial auto-review P1s were treated as evidence rather than authority: two matched CI regressions and were fixed without weakening old invariants; the third identified a real task-admission escape hatch and the gate now validates exact UAOS controller-task -> changed Evolution linkage.
selected_repair_candidate: front-loaded CRITICAL pre-action self-falsification/problem gate in Custom Instructions and generated Skill
generated native Skill projection from canonical owners with exact regeneration test
native control-plane promotion gate requiring exact linked UAOS controller task and Evolution trace
removal of PR #83 hand-added ten-rule layer
active GitHub protect-main ruleset requiring PR plus promotion-gate with empty bypass
remaining_user_owned_actions: after production promotion, replace the installed Skill and Custom Instructions with the newly generated production copies
run one new fresh-chat holdout probe after replacement
